data.desc: Nortech Systems Incorporated ('Nortech') is a leading provider of design and manufacturing solutions for complex electromedical devices, electromechanical systems, assemblies, and components. Nortech primarily serves the medical device, medical imaging, aerospace & defense, and industrial markets. Its design services span concept development to commercial design, and include medical device, software, electrical, mechanical, and biomedical engineering. Its manufacturing and supply chain capabilities are vertically integrated around wire/cable/interconnect assemblies, printed circuit board assemblies, as well as system-level assembly, integration, and final test. Headquartered in Maple Grove, MN, Nortech currently has six manufacturing locations and design centers across the U.S., Latin America, and Asia. Nortech is traded on the NASDAQ Stock Market under the symbol NSYS. Nortech's website is www.nortechsys.com.
